title: fix(app-shell): a record page offers the reactions column write only where sys_comment still declares the column
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_

Fixes #33521

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Stacked on #33499** (branch `claude/area-E1-33343`, head e7b95effb8, not merged when this was opened): this branch was cut from it, so until #33499 lands the diff below also shows its two commits. The commits of this PR are the last three.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页讨论区里,对 `sys_comment_reaction` 没有读权限的用户不再看到表情回应按钮;只有在框架确实没有该对象(`sys_comment` 仍声明 `reactions` 列,如 cloud 的 v17)时才走旧的列写入路径。
- 为什么改:被拒读该对象的用户(自定义权限集、外部/门户用户)原先被引到已退役的 `sys_comment.reactions` 列,每次点击都是 `PATCH` 并得到 `400 INVALID_FIELD`。
- 风险与回滚:只改控制台的存储选择;判断依据是 `sys_comment` 自身的定义是否声明 `reactions`(该列与新对象在同一版本 18.0.0 一退一进)。回滚即还原本 PR 三个提交。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(`reactionStore` 一段与 `declaresReactionsColumn`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useObjectPresence.ts`(新增 `definition`)、`RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`,预期 29 个用例全绿,其中 #33521 的四个(两个被拒、两个 CONTROL)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(须待 #33499 先合并)。

## What changes

- **Store pick** (`RecordDetailView.tsx`): the reaction store was `column` whenever `sys_comment_reaction` could not be read (refused by the loaded grants, or answered absent by the registry). A refusal and an undeployed object read alike: the metadata door answers a refused caller's definition read as absent, and grants name neither. The page now reads `sys_comment`'s own served definition in that case and takes `column` only where it declares `reactions`. The column left `sys_comment` in the same release that added `sys_comment_reaction` (plugin-audit 18.0.0, migration entry `sys-comment-reactions-column-retired`), so a definition that declares it is a framework without the object, and one that does not refuses a write naming it. Anywhere else the store is `none`: no reaction control, no reaction read, no reaction request.
- **Hook** (`useObjectPresence.ts`): the reading also carries the object's served `definition` when it is present (additive, optional field), so the page reads `sys_comment`'s fields without a second registry read. The `sys_comment` definition is asked only when the reaction object is unread.
- No server change, no new signal: the signals are the loaded grants, the reaction object's meta answer, and `sys_comment`'s meta answer.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`:

- refused by grants, on a framework with the object (registry serves `sys_comment` without `reactions`): no add-reaction control, no stored chip read off the column, zero `sys_comment` updates naming `reactions`, zero reaction reads, zero creates;
- no permission provider, registry answers the object absent on the same framework: no control, no column write;
- CONTROL undeployed (`sys_comment` declares `reactions`): control offered, the chip click writes `sys_comment` `reactions` once, no reaction read;
- CONTROL grant held: records store, one reaction read, the click creates the caller's own `sys_comment_reaction` row, no column write.

Fixture triage: the column-store suites (`reactionRecords-12078` absent registry, `reactionKeepIds-11019`, `reactionWriteFailure-10899`, `reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035`, and `feedGrant-12082`'s column registry) served a registry with no `sys_comment` at all, a deployment that never existed. Each now serves the `sys_comment` a pre-18 framework serves, declaring `reactions` (a missing declaration, not a changed assertion).

## Acceptance notes

- A refused caller gets no read-only counts: reading them needs read on `sys_comment_reaction`, which is exactly what the caller lacks, so there is nothing to show.
- After #33584 a stock member holds read on the object and takes the records store; this change covers every caller still refused and does not depend on #33584.
- With no permission provider and no metadata registry that serves `sys_comment`, the store is `none` (previously `column` only on the refused-by-grants path): the column write is offered only on evidence that the column exists.

</details>

Restore: blob equals HEAD a63343be76, `git diff HEAD` empty.
